name: 万灵种囊
text: 你的回合开始时，若你拥有至少3个友方单位，抽1张牌。
flavor: 囊里的种子会自己数人头，人够了，就吐一粒出来。

art.subject: a small embroidered pouch of green silk bulging with glowing seeds, a few tiny sprouts poking out of its drawstring mouth, resting on moss

name: 山鬼骨笛
text: 战斗开始时，召唤一个「山魅」。每回合第一次有友方单位死亡时，抽1张牌。
flavor: 吹的是山里死去的风，唤回的是山里没走远的魂。

art.subject: a bone flute carved from a deer antler, wrapped with a strand of red cord and dried fig leaves, pale green mist curling from its finger holes

name: 建木新芽
text: 战斗开始时，召唤2个「灵苗」。
flavor: 建木落下的种子，一粒能养活一片林。

art.subject: a large glowing seed shaped like a jade teardrop resting in cupped roots, two tiny sapling spirits sprouting from it, soft green light

name: 枯荣鼓
text: 每当一个友方单位死亡，对一名随机敌人造成3点伤害。
flavor: 鼓面蒙的是枯叶，敲一下，山里便少一个活物。

art.subject: a small hand drum covered with dried autumn leaves instead of hide, bound with vines, a pale ghostly wisp rising from it

name: 旧蜕
text: 战斗开始时，召唤2个「灵苗」。
flavor: 他每蜕一次皮，就留下一只空壳。

art.subject: a pair of amber cicada shells wrapped in a leaf, tiny sprouts growing from their backs

name: 轮回印
text: 每当一个友方单位死亡，对随机敌人造成2点伤害。
flavor: 印面刻着一个圆，没有开头也没有结尾。

art.subject: a jade seal carved with an endless ring of vines and a cicada in the center
